Heading: Delete account
Desc: Permanently delete your account and everything stored with it on this server.
LoadFailed: Could not check whether your account can be deleted. Please try again later.
DemoUnavailable: Accounts cannot be deleted on the demo instance.
OwnerBlocked: You are the owner of this installation and administer it, so your account cannot be deleted while other accounts exist. Remove the other users below, or keep your account.
RemoveUserWarning: The account of {0} and all of its data will be deleted permanently from this installation. This cannot be undone.
ItemData: All your notes, study sessions, courses, goals, grades, templates and settings
ItemAccess: Your passkeys, recovery codes and every device that is signed in
ItemIntegrations: All API keys, connected apps, push notification registrations and your calendar link
ItemAddons: Data held by add-ons (AI assistant, webhooks, developer portal). If an add-on is offline, the deletion there is retried until it succeeds
OwnedAppsText: You registered {0} app(s) as a developer. They are deleted as well, and other people's integrations with them stop working.
LastUserText: You are the only account on this installation. Deleting it returns the installation to its first-run state, and a new setup code appears in the server log.
NotDeletedBackups: Server backups made earlier still contain a copy until they rotate out (weekly copies: four weeks, managed database backups: 30 days).
NotDeletedPasskeys: Passkeys saved in your password manager or on your devices. Remove those there yourself.
NotDeletedCalendar: Events that other calendar apps already fetched through your calendar link.
ExportFailed: The export could not be downloaded.
ConfirmCheckbox: I understand that my account and all its data will be deleted permanently.
ReauthText: Confirm with a passkey of this account. The deletion starts right after.
BrowserSignInText: Sign in again to confirm. The deletion starts right after.
ErrorProofRejected: That confirmation was not accepted. Nothing was deleted.
ErrorPasskeyUnavailable: The passkey prompt did not complete. Try again, or use a recovery code.
ErrorTooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes.
ErrorNetwork: The server could not be reached. Nothing was deleted.
ErrorOwner: The owner cannot be deleted while other users exist.
ErrorGeneric: Something went wrong. Nothing was deleted.
AddonPending: Clean-up at connected add-ons is still pending and finishes automatically.
